verses.text: A song of ascents. Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—

xrefs.text: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
“Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says: ‘I remember the devotion of your youth, your love as a bride, how you followed Me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.
A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.

verses.text: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.

xrefs.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
But the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.

verses.text: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.

xrefs.text: I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.”
As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

verses.text: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.

xrefs.text: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.

To You, O Lord, belongs righteousness, but this day we are covered with shame— the men of Judah, the people of Jerusalem, and all Israel near and far, in all the countries to which You have driven us because of our unfaithfulness to You.
The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah

verses.text: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

xrefs.text: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’”
On that day, when all the nations of the earth gather against her, I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who would heave it away will be severely injured.
this is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: ‘The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you; the Daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you.
saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

verses.text: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,

xrefs.text: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
Therefore their inhabitants, devoid of power, are dismayed and ashamed. They are like plants in the field, tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops, scorched before it is grown.
that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

verses.text: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.

xrefs.text: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
For you have forgotten the God of your salvation and failed to remember the Rock of your refuge. Therefore, though you cultivate delightful plots and set out cuttings from exotic vines—
He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind. There is no standing grain; what sprouts fails to yield flour. Even if it should produce, the foreigners would swallow it up.

verses.text: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”

xrefs.text: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and said to the harvesters, “The LORD be with you.” “The LORD bless you,” they replied.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
